judge.rationale: The candidate delivers the basic WebSocket message types, configuration plumbing, and handler dispatch, but fails several explicit acceptance criteria and contains broken spec links. Specifically, `validation.ts` allows `limit: 0` and `limit > 200` even though the ticket explicitly requires `limit` to be an integer between 1–200 and `limit: 0` or `201` to be invalid. Furthermore, `specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md` was written against an earlier draft using `list_sessions` and `session_list` with incorrect line numbers and test names, which breaks `check:spec-links` and `spec:names`. The candidate also logs the raw store error message instead of redacting store details on `listFor` rejection, and omits several required tests (off-lock streaming concurrency, end-to-end resume with a listed `sessionId`, and additive protocol fixture tests) as well as the `docs/getting-started.md` § Conversation list section and startup warning when `history` is enabled without `resume`.
